records.manufacturer_description_en: Implausible values from one or more wheel speed sensors
records.translation_ar: قراءات غير منطقية من حساس أو أكثر لسرعة العجلات

applicability.market: Not independently established for Sweden/EU; bulletin metadata may reflect US distribution

probable_causes: Defective rear hub multipole encoder ring in specified production batch
Wheel speed sensor/connector issue remains possible elsewhere
diagnostic_steps: Confirm vehicle build date is within 2015-10-10 to 2015-11-13 and read ESP fault memory.
Open XENTRY N30/4 > Current data > Wheel speeds and road test straight at 40–50 km/h in safe conditions.
Compare all four wheel-speed signals, identify sensor or axle reading approximately 10% low per bulletin; verify mechanical encoder/assembly before replacing bearing.
Recheck DTCs after targeted repair; avoid applying bearing remedy outside this narrow production range.

Check current software and repeat fault-memory test; do not replace sensors solely on listed DTCs.

records.manufacturer_description_en: Implausible compressed-air system pressure sensor signal
records.translation_ar: إشارة غير منطقية من حساس ضغط منظومة الهواء المضغوط

applicability.market: Not independently established for Sweden/EU; bulletin metadata may reflect US distribution

symptoms: Fuse f114 at K40/8 overloaded in illustrated complaint
probable_causes: Moisture or corrosion in compressor A9/1 connector m1
Connector/harness short circuit
Pressure sensor/air reservoir issue must be independently demonstrated
diagnostic_steps: Verify 205 has code 489, scan N51/3 and identify corresponding fault.
Inspect engine fuse/relay unit K40/8 fuse f114 and compressor A9/1 connector m1 for moisture, damaged seal or corrosion.
Follow OEM-safe depressurization and moisture/corrosion remediation procedure, using approved repair parts and wiring repair instructions.
If no connector defect found, run approved AIRMATIC pressure/reservoir/actuator guided tests; do not replace compressor solely on fault text.
